title: Sequential Composition Has Positive Duration
statement: Let $M_1,M_2$ be machines with the same number of work tapes and input alphabet, and state sets $S_1,S_2$. Let $C_1$ be a contract for $M_1$ from entry state $e_1$ with exit set $\\{\\mathrm{some}(f_1)\\}$, and let $C_2$ be a contract for $M_2$ from entry state $e_2$ with exit set $X_2$. Let $\\ell$ map the data values of $C_1$ to those of $C_2$, and suppose that for every admissible $C_1$ start in state $e_1$, the endpoint of $C_1$, with its state replaced by $e_2$, satisfies the $C_2$ precondition at data value $\\ell(i)$. Then the sequentially composed contract, which runs $C_1$, takes one transition to switch machines, and then runs $C_2$, has strictly positive assigned running time for every admissible start in its entry state.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ have the same number of work tapes and input alphabet
$C_1$ is a contract for $M_1$ with entry $e_1$ and singleton exit set $\\{\\mathrm{some}(f_1)\\}$
$C_2$ is a contract for $M_2$ with entry $e_2$ and exit set $X_2$
$\\ell$ maps the data values of $C_1$ to those of $C_2$
Every admissible $C_1$ endpoint, with state replaced by $e_2$, satisfies the corresponding $C_2$ precondition
replaced:
Let $M_1,M_2$ be machines with respective entry and exit states
$\mathrm{entry}_1,\mathrm{exit}_1$ for $M_1$, and entry state $\mathrm{entry}_2$ for
$M_2$. Let $C_1$ be a contract for $M_1$ with sole exit state $\mathrm{exit}_1$, and let
$C_2$ be a contract for $M_2$ with exit set $X_2$. Suppose a map from the indices of
$C_1$ to those of $C_2$ sends every admissible $C_1$ start to a configuration satisfying
the $C_2$ precondition, after the $C_1$ endpoint has been relabeled constantly to
$\mathrm{entry}_2$. Then the sequentially composed contract $C_1;C_2$ has strictly
positive duration for every admissible start in its entry state.
